<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 700 480" width="700" height="480">
  <!-- White Background -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="700" height="480" fill="#ffffff" />

  <style>
    text {
      font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif;
      font-size: 16px;
      fill: #000000;
    }
    .label-text {
      font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: bold;
    }
    .caption {
      font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: 16px;
    }
    .membrane-part {
      fill: #ffffff;
      stroke: #000000;
      stroke-width: 2;
    }
    .protein {
      fill: #e0e0e0;
      stroke: #000000;
      stroke-width: 2;
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Phospholipid drawing helper:
       Head: circle r=8
       Tail 1 & 2: wavy/bent lines
       Y-positions for upper layer: heads at y=130, tails hang down to y=200
       Y-positions for lower layer: heads at y=270, tails point up to y=200
  -->

  <!-- Upper Phospholipid Layer (Heads up, tails down) -->
  <!-- We'll draw roughly 12 pairs across from x=150 to x=550 -->
  <!-- Let's define specific x positions for upper layer -->
  
  <!-- We will programmatically/manually place 10 pairs to look natural -->
  
  <!-- UPPER LAYER -->
  <!-- x = 160, 200, 240, 280, 320, 360, 400, 440, 480, 520, 560 -->
  
  <!-- Protein 1 (Glycoprotein) spans x=210 to x=280 roughly -->
  <!-- Protein 2 (Channel) spans x=410 to x=480 roughly -->

  <!-- phospholipid macro for upper layer -->
  <!-- h=130, t=190 -->
  <!-- 1 --> <circle cx="150" cy="130" r="9" class="membrane-part"/><path d="M146,139 C140,160 155,175 148,195 M154,139 C160,160 145,175 152,195" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- 2 --> <circle cx="185" cy="130" r="9" class="membrane-part"/><path d="M181,139 C175,160 190,175 183,195 M189,139 C195,160 180,175 187,195" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Gap for Protein A (Glycoprotein) at ~240 to 320 -->
  
  <!-- 3 --> <circle cx="330" cy="130" r="9" class="membrane-part"/><path d="M326,139 C320,160 335,175 328,195 M334,139 C340,160 325,175 332,195" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- 4 --> <circle cx="365" cy="130" r="9" class="membrane-part"/><path d="M361,139 C355,160 370,175 363,195 M369,139 C375,160 360,175 367,195" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Cholesterol between 365 and 400 in upper layer -->
  <!-- Cholesterol representation: 4 fused rings (tetragon/hexagon cluster) -->
  <g transform="translate(390, 140) rotate(-15)">
    <polygon points="0,0 12,-4 18,6 6,12" class="membrane-part"/>
    <polygon points="12,-4 24,-8 30,2 18,6" class="membrane-part"/>
    <polygon points="24,-8 32,-16 40,-8 30,2" class="membrane-part"/>
    <polygon points="18,6 30,2 36,14 24,18" class="membrane-part"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 5 --> <circle cx="410" cy="130" r="9" class="membrane-part"/><path d="M406,139 C400,160 415,175 408,195 M414,139 C420,160 405,175 412,195" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Gap for Channel Protein at ~430 to 510 -->

  <!-- 6 --> <circle cx="530" cy="130" r="9" class="membrane-part"/><path d="M526,139 C520,160 535,175 528,195 M534,139 C540,160 525,175 532,195" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- 7 --> <circle cx="565" cy="130" r="9" class="membrane-part"/><path d="M561,139 C555,160 570,175 563,195 M569,139 C575,160 560,175 567,195" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>


  <!-- LOWER LAYER (Heads down at y=270, tails up to y=210) -->
  <!-- 1 --> <circle cx="150" cy="270" r="9" class="membrane-part"/><path d="M146,261 C140,240 155,225 148,205 M154,261 C160,240 145,225 152,205" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- 2 --> <circle cx="185" cy="270" r="9" class="membrane-part"/><path d="M181,261 C175,240 190,225 183,205 M189,261 C195,240 180,225 187,205" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Gap for Glycoprotein -->

  <!-- 3 --> <circle cx="330" cy="270" r="9" class="membrane-part"/><path d="M326,261 C320,240 335,225 328,205 M334,261 C340,240 325,225 332,205" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- 4 --> <circle cx="365" cy="270" r="9" class="membrane-part"/><path d="M361,261 C355,240 370,225 363,205 M369,261 C375,240 360,225 367,205" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- 5 --> <circle cx="400" cy="270" r="9" class="membrane-part"/><path d="M396,261 C390,240 405,225 398,205 M404,261 C410,240 395,225 402,205" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Gap for Channel Protein -->

  <!-- 6 --> <circle cx="530" cy="270" r="9" class="membrane-part"/><path d="M526,261 C520,240 535,225 528,205 M534,261 C540,240 525,225 532,205" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- 7 --> <circle cx="565" cy="270" r="9" class="membrane-part"/><path d="M561,261 C555,240 570,225 563,205 M569,261 C575,240 560,225 567,205" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>


  <!-- PROTEIN 1: Glycoprotein (spanning membrane from x=210 to x=310, y=110 to y=290) -->
  <path d="M 210,120 
           C 205,110 220,100 230,105 
           C 250,95  270,95  290,105 
           C 300,100 315,110 310,120
           L 310,280
           C 315,290 300,300 290,295
           C 270,305 250,305 230,295
           C 220,300 205,290 210,280
           Z" class="protein" />

  <!-- Carbohydrate chain attached to Protein 1 (branched chain of small hexagons/circles) -->
  <!-- Branch 1 -->
  <circle cx="250" cy="85" r="5" fill="#fff" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="238" cy="72" r="5" fill="#fff" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="262" cy="72" r="5" fill="#fff" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="226" cy="60" r="5" fill="#fff" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M250,90 L250,85 M250,80 L238,75 M250,80 L262,75 M238,67 L226,63" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5"/>


  <!-- PROTEIN 2: Channel Protein (two parts spanning membrane, with a gap between them) -->
  <!-- Left part of channel protein -->
  <path d="M 430,120 
           C 425,110 435,100 445,105 
           L 445,295
           C 435,300 425,290 430,280
           L 435,200
           L 430,120 Z" class="protein" />

  <!-- Right part of channel protein -->
  <path d="M 475,105 
           C 485,100 495,110 490,120
           L 490,280
           C 495,290 485,300 475,295
           L 475,105 Z" class="protein" />


  <!-- LABEL LINES AND TEXT -->

  <!-- A: Carbohydrate chain -->
  <text x="140" y="50" class="label-text">A</text>
  <path d="M 152,55 Q 210,55 238,65" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- B: Phospholipid head -->
  <text x="600" y="110" class="label-text">B</text>
  <path d="M 592,105 L 575,110 Q 550,125 538,130" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- C: Channel through channel protein -->
  <text x="460" y="45" class="label-text">C</text>
  <path d="M 463,55 L 463,90" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- D: Cholesterol -->
  <text x="330" y="70" class="label-text">D</text>
  <path d="M 355,75 Q 375,110 385,135" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- E: Tails -->
  <text x="600" y="215" class="label-text">E</text>
  <path d="M 592,210 L 520,210" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5"/>


  <!-- Caption -->
  <text x="310" y="440" class="caption" text-anchor="middle">Fig. 8.1</text>

</svg>
